rec.name: Cart Up-/Cross-Selling Carousel
rec.status: Built — launched (Focal theme; other themes need code adaptation)

what.text: A recommendation block inside the cart drawer and cart page that suggests complementary products (e.g. 'Passt perfekt dazu' / 'Perfect match') below the cart line items. Items can be shown as a horizontal slider or stacked vertically. Each item has an image, title and an Add button. Optional teaser text, price (with compare-at price and savings) and star rating can be shown. Products with variants open a variant-selection popup (swatches and an add-to-cart button) before being added. Headline, sub-headline, text color and background color are configurable.

why.text: Cart is a high-intent moment, so complementary add-ons are accepted more easily and raise AOV. Items are low-friction, one-click adds that don't interrupt checkout. The sub-headline ('8 out of 10 customers also buy') adds a social-proof/bandwagon cue. Optional ratings and savings text reinforce trust and perceived value. Product-specific recommendations via metafield add relevance.

how.text: Built for the Focal theme. (1) Add a 'Cart Upsell' group to settings_schema.json with: show/hide checkbox, display select (horizontal slider / vertical), headline, sub-headline, product_list (limit 5), text color, background color, and checkboxes for teaser, price and rating. (2) Create snippet cart-upsell.liquid: it collects products from the product metafield custom.cart_upsell (product list) of every cart item, de-duplicates them, and excludes products already in the cart. If no metafield products exist, it falls back to the global product list in theme settings. It renders each one via upsell-product-temp, and renders a variant popup per product. (3) Create upsell-popup-temp.liquid: a bottom-sheet popup with image, title, price, option swatches (color swatches vs. text buttons, sold-out variants dimmed) and an add-to-cart button. (4) Create upsell-product-temp.liquid: the item row with image, title link, optional teaser (teaser-text snippet), optional rating (product-rating snippet, i.e. a placeholder for a review app) and optional price block with compare-at price and 'You save X'. A slick slider with arrows handles the horizontal mode. Slider/AJAX add-to-cart JS is not in the file and was shown in a Loom video. Ratings and teaser text depend on existing theme snippets. To show it during an A/B test while hidden in settings, use the CSS override `.cart-upsell{display:block !important;}`. Design styles from the references (Impact 'Sound', Concept 'Harmony', doonails, true-nature) need only CSS tweaks.

items: Sub-headline text (default '8 von 10 Kunden kaufen zusätzlich')
Show ratings/reviews (default off; star colors adjustable)

dependencies.text: Product metafield custom.cart_upsell (type: list of products) for per-product recommendations. Falls back to a theme-settings product list. Built for the Focal theme (cart drawer; slick slider; teaser-text and product-rating snippets; color-swatch-style snippet and color_swatch_config setting). The rating snippet is a placeholder for a review app (e.g. reviews.io). Requires dev work (no-code install not possible). Ticket notes KVA (cost estimate) approval: yes. Not portable to other themes without code changes. Cart JS (add-to-cart, slider init, popup toggling) is not included in the provided file (I).

images.caption: Impact 'Sound' reference: 'Complete with' heading, slider arrows, bordered cards with image, bold title, price and pill '+ Add' button.
Concept 'Harmony' reference: 'You may also like' with circular prev/next arrows, product image, title, price and dark '+ Add' button.
doonails reference: 'Recommended for your selection', light gray cards, image, title, price and bag-plus icon button.
true-nature reference: 'Passt perfekt dazu:' on tinted green cards with image, title, star rating with review count and a green 'Hinzufügen' button.
Theme editor settings for 'Cart upsell': display mode, headline, sub-headline, product list, text/background color, teaser/price/reviews toggles.
Final UI in the cart drawer: headline and sub-headline, slider arrows, product thumbnail, uppercase title and black 'Hinzufügen' button below the cart item.
